rules.text: First switchFeed attaches the requested feed and activates exactly that listener.
Replacing an active subscription must await detach of the old handle before attaching the new feed; old cleanup completes before new activation.
If old-handle detach fails, rethrow that exact error unchanged, emit cleanup-error, keep the old subscription active, and do not attach or activate the replacement.
Callbacks are generation-fenced. After successful replacement, a callback from any older handle is ignored and emits stale-drop; only current callback emits deliver.
close is idempotent. First stop detaches the active handle then clears active state and emits stop; later stop calls perform no detach and no new trace event.

Trace is append-only/copied. attach precedes activate for first subscription; replacement orders detach -> attach -> activate; cleanup-error occurs after failed detach; delivery decisions are deliver/stale-drop.

callableSurface.ownership: The subscription manager owns active handle, generation fence and trace. Caller owns transport and callback.

eventOrdering: replacement cleanup detach completes before new attach
failed detach emits cleanup-error and prevents attach/activate
first stop detaches before stop event
abortErrorPrecedence: No abort surface. Old-handle cleanup failure has precedence over replacement attach and leaves old subscription active.

identityMutation.inputs: subscription names and callback payloads are read only
identityMutation.generation: every successful activation gets a new generation; older callbacks cannot deliver
